nodes.norm_label: vban_jitter (lock-free jitter buffer, plc, adaptive latency, drift/src)

nodes.label: vban_rx (demux, PING0 responder, reassembly, RT-Packet server)
nodes.norm_label: vban_rx (demux, ping0 responder, reassembly, rt-packet server)

nodes.label: vban_seq frame counter tracking (loss, dup, reorder, wrap, restart)
nodes.norm_label: vban_seq frame counter tracking (loss, dup, reorder, wrap, restart)

nodes.label: Limits (IPv4 only, no VBCA/VBCV decode, linear resampler)
nodes.norm_label: limits (ipv4 only, no vbca/vbcv decode, linear resampler)

nodes.label: PING0 device names cut to printable ASCII
nodes.norm_label: ping0 device names cut to printable ascii
nodes.rationale: Invalid modified UTF-8 would make CheckJNI abort the app.

nodes.label: Real-time safe read() via GetPrimitiveArrayCritical
nodes.rationale: Pins the Java array and lets the lock-free jitter buffer fill it directly: no copy, lock, allocation or syscall; sendto() never called inside a critical region.

nodes.label: Security: every datagram is hostile
nodes.rationale: VBAN has no authentication and source addresses can be forged; audit found no memory corruption but 9 abuse issues; remaining limits need an AEAD secure mode, so keep VBAN on trusted networks or a VPN.

nodes.label: ESP-IDF main component (main.c, arduino/vban_smoke include)
nodes.rationale: No REQUIRES so main depends on every component, including the SDK one whose name is the checkout directory name.

nodes.label: End-to-end tx_write to jb_push loopback latency (p50 10 us)
nodes.norm_label: end-to-end tx_write to jb_push loopback latency (p50 10 us)

nodes.label: Platform verification (Linux, aarch64, Android, MinGW, ESP-IDF, Arduino)
nodes.norm_label: platform verification (linux, aarch64, android, mingw, esp-idf, arduino)

nodes.label: libm link probe (check_library_exists lrintf)
nodes.rationale: find_library() misses libm in cross toolchains without CMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH and silently drops -lm, so linking is probed instead.

nodes.label: Kernel receive thread with frame-counter ring
nodes.norm_label: kernel receive thread with frame-counter ring

nodes.label: Netsim results: wired LAN, Wi-Fi good/congested, WAN/VPN
nodes.norm_label: netsim results: wired lan, wi-fi good/congested, wan/vpn

nodes.label: Physical latency floor (p99.9 jitter sets latency, not the SDK)
nodes.norm_label: physical latency floor (p99.9 jitter sets latency, not the sdk)

nodes.label: Playout-deadline jitter buffer (ADR-001)
nodes.rationale: Packets placed by frame counter so reordered packets and late redundant copies fill holes before playout; concealment at playout time distinguishes loss (clock keeps running) from starvation (playout holds), avoiding silence + re-prime.

nodes.label: Redundant copies loss protection (vban_tx_set_redundancy)
nodes.rationale: Time-diversity copies n packets later (~5 ms) cut audible loss 79-91% with no latency cost at 2x bandwidth; byte-identical so normal receivers see a normal stream; only enabled for SDK receivers since Voicemeeter duplicate handling is unverified.

nodes.label: XOR parity FEC (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Repaired only 20% on Wi-Fi because burst losses take out two packets per group, and would need a non-standard packet type, so not adopted.

nodes.label: VBAN SDK for Android (Kotlin library vban.sdk)
nodes.norm_label: vban sdk for android (kotlin library vban.sdk)

nodes.label: Two-atomic usage guard for close()
nodes.rationale: close() may race read()/write() from any thread; guard waits for the in-flight call and later calls return 0, preventing use-after-free.

nodes.label: Export only JNI entry points (--exclude-libs,ALL, gc-sections)
nodes.norm_label: export only jni entry points (--exclude-libs,all, gc-sections)
nodes.rationale: Avoids symbol clashes with another library embedding the SDK and keeps the .so small.

nodes.label: Example tool executables (vban_send, vban_recv, vban_ping, vban_text, vban_mixer_demo, vban_monitor)
nodes.norm_label: example tool executables (vban_send, vban_recv, vban_ping, vban_text, vban_mixer_demo, vban_monitor)

nodes.label: snd-vban module parameters (dest, tx_name, listen_port, rx_name, rate, fpp, rx_target)
nodes.norm_label: snd-vban module parameters (dest, tx_name, listen_port, rx_name, rate, fpp, rx_target)

nodes.label: snd-vban ALSA virtual sound card driver
nodes.norm_label: snd-vban alsa virtual sound card driver

nodes.label: snd-vban locking (pcm_lock, rx_lock, work_mutex)
nodes.rationale: work_mutex held by clock thread and taken by .sync_stop so hw_free/close never race an in-flight copy or period_elapsed(); sendmsg only called with no spinlock held.

nodes.label: vban_mixer (N x M matrix mixer, ramps, limiter)
nodes.norm_label: vban_mixer (n x m matrix mixer, ramps, limiter)

nodes.label: vban_net (UDP POSIX/Winsock, recvmmsg/sendmmsg, clock, RT priority)
nodes.norm_label: vban_net (udp posix/winsock, recvmmsg/sendmmsg, clock, rt priority)

nodes.label: Design goals: no heap, no blocking in audio path, byte-exact wire handling
nodes.norm_label: design goals: no heap, no blocking in audio path, byte-exact wire handling

nodes.label: shim/ mapping userspace headers to kernel headers (integer-only)
nodes.norm_label: shim/ mapping userspace headers to kernel headers (integer-only)

nodes.label: Interpretations where the spec is silent or ambiguous
nodes.norm_label: interpretations where the spec is silent or ambiguous
nodes.rationale: Choices follow reference implementations in the wild (thib3113/vban, vban-cmd, VBAN-Key, Voicemeeter); parsing is lenient by default, VBAN_PARSE_STRICT for conformance; little-endian encoded byte-by-byte.

nodes.label: No fast-math / -fno-trapping-math float policy
nodes.rationale: MSVC keeps /fp:precise because fast-math folds v == v to true and lets hostile NaN samples past the float sanitizer in vban_pcm.c; GCC/Clang get -fno-math-errno -fno-trapping-math so the float clamp loop vectorizes.

nodes.label: Optimization log (measure, change one thing, re-measure)
nodes.norm_label: optimization log (measure, change one thing, re-measure)
nodes.rationale: -fno-trapping-math enabled vectorization of f32->s16 clamp; non-vectorizable paths kept lrintf; microsecond waits cut vban_recv CPU 12.7%->4.1%; adaptive target floored at pull+packet size; SEC-005 sanitizer done as integer clamp in noinline restrict helper.

nodes.label: Capture idle re-anchoring
nodes.rationale: Packets counted but not buffered while nobody captures; each capture start re-anchors to the live stream so it never starts from stale audio (fixes the stale capture timeline bug).
